summary: Pipeline-based lead management CRM with visual stages, basic assignment, integrated calling/text/email, manager oversight, conversion reporting, inventory linkage, and rule-based follow-up automation.
sequential_topics: Overview of CRM dashboard and purpose
Sidebar navigation for leads, deals, contacts, and reporting
Lead intake from website and third-party marketplaces
Pipeline stages from new to sold
Lead actions including assign, call, text, and email
Manager view for team performance and distribution
